generic_domain.justification: Fine-tuning is the most generic and comprehensive Research Domain because it serves as the foundation for all specific approaches mentioned in the list. The other domains, such as 'parameter-efficient fine-tuning' and 'task-aware fine-tuning', are specialized techniques that fall under the broader umbrella of fine-tuning. By selecting 'fine-tuning', we encompass all these specialized methods within a single general category.
